judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are short, warm, and one question at a time. Examples include "A ballpark is fine" and "Last one: how soon would you like to move forward?". The rhythm is slightly templated, with acknowledgments rotating between "Got it", "Thanks", and "Great" and no personalization beyond the name.
judge.experience_rationale: Robin answered cooperatively throughout. At [10], the agent set expectations honestly ("I'm not checking your credit"). At [16], Robin learned exactly who will call, how, and roughly when, without any rate or approval promise.
judge.handoff_summary_rationale: The summary accurately reflects every borrower answer: rate-and-term, $480k value, $290k balance, 7%, 740+, primary residence, within 3 months. The LTV of 0.604 is correct and the borrower's goal is quoted verbatim. The open question and recommended next step are actionable, so a loan officer could call immediately.

annotations.note: The agent discloses its AI identity upfront ("an automated assistant"), references the inquiry, checks timing, and offers STOP.
The agent confirms the form's goal and clarifies the cash-out question in one natural sentence instead of re-asking from scratch.
"This is just your own estimate and I'm not checking your credit" reassures the borrower and avoids implying any credit decision.
The handoff message states who (a licensed loan officer), how (call at this number), and when ("usually within 5 minutes"), and it notes they "may confirm a few details" without quoting rates.
The acknowledgments ("Got it." / "Thanks.") are repetitive across turns 4-12, which gives the exchange a slightly scripted cadence.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, compliant qualification flow with no objections raised, honest expectation-setting, and an accurate, actionable handoff. The only minor weakness is somewhat formulaic acknowledgment phrasing.
